title: Lonely Pixel I
description:
Given an m x n picture consisting of black 'B' and white 'W' pixels, return the number of black lonely pixels . 
 
 A black lonely pixel is a character 'B' that located at a specific position where the same row and same column don't have any other black pixels. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/11/pixel1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 picture = [["W","W","B"],["W","B","W"],["B","W","W"]]

Output:
 3

Explanation:
 All the three 'B's are black lonely pixels.
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/11/pixel2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 picture = [["B","B","B"],["B","B","W"],["B","B","B"]]

Output:
 0
```

 Constraints: 

 m == picture.length 
 
 n == picture[i].length 
 
 1 <= m, n <= 500 
 
 picture[i][j] is 'W' or 'B' .
